title: Your phone
about: The parts of a phone, like the screen, battery and charger. What we do with a smartphone: call, text, take selfies, lock and unlock it, save and delete things.

items.pattern: a phone camera · the front / back camera
items.meaning: the part of a phone that takes photos and videos
items.example: The **camera** on Dad's new phone takes really clear photos.
more: I use the front **camera** for video calls with my cousin.
Clean the **camera**. There's a fingerprint on it.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈkæmərə/ — наголос на першому складі, середнє «e» майже не чути: KAM-ra.

items.pattern: the screen · on the screen · a big / cracked screen
items.meaning: the flat glass part of a phone where you see pictures and words
items.example: The **screen** is too dark. I can't see the photo.
more: There's a small crack in the corner of my **screen**.
What's that on your **screen**? Is it a new game?
items.watchOut: На екрані — on the screen, а не in the screen.

items.pattern: an app · apps · a music / weather / game app
items.meaning: something on your phone that you use for one thing, like music, maps or games
items.example: I use a map **app** when I go to a new city.
more: My favourite **app** has funny videos about animals.
How many **apps** have you got on your phone?
items.watchOut: App — коротко від application. Кажуть an app (з an), бо слово починається з голосного звука /æ/.

items.pattern: press / hold the power button
items.meaning: the button that turns your phone on and off
items.example: My phone stopped working, so I held the **power button** and turned it off and on again.
more: The **power button** is on the side of the phone.
Don't press the **power button** in your pocket by mistake.
items.watchOut: Вмикати / вимикати телефон — turn on / turn off (або switch on / off). Не include: це калька з «включати».

items.pattern: a phone case · put a case on your phone
items.meaning: a cover that keeps your phone safe
items.example: I've got a **phone case** with cats on it.
more: This **phone case** has a little pocket for my bus card.
My brother made his own **phone case** in art class.

items.pattern: a (phone) charger · charge your phone
items.meaning: the thing with a cable that puts power back into your phone
items.example: I always keep a **charger** in my school bag.
more: This **charger** is for my tablet, not for my phone.
Don't leave the **charger** on the floor. Someone might fall over it.
items.watchOut: «Зарядка» (річ) — a charger, а не a charge. Заряджати телефон — charge your phone.

items.pattern: the battery is low / dead / full
items.meaning: the part inside a phone that keeps the power
items.example: This phone has a big **battery**. It lasts two days.
more: Is your **battery** OK? We need the map on the way home.
The **battery** died in the middle of the film.
items.watchOut: Батарея майже сіла — my battery is low. Сіла зовсім — my battery is dead / my phone is dead, а не sat down.

items.pattern: a SIM card · put a SIM card in your phone
items.meaning: a very small card in your phone with your phone number on it
items.example: Dad bought a cheap **SIM card** at the airport.
more: My old **SIM card** doesn't fit in the new phone. It's too big.
My phone has space for two **SIM cards**.
items.watchOut: SIM читається як слово: /sɪm/, з коротким «і». Тому кажуть a SIM card, з a.

items.pattern: take a selfie · take selfies · a selfie with sb
items.meaning: take a photo of yourself with your phone
items.example: We **took a selfie** with our teacher on the last day of school.
more: Our dog sits very still when we **take a selfie**.
Can you **take a selfie** with the cake before we eat it?
items.watchOut: Зробити фото чи селфі — take a photo / take a selfie. Make a photo — типова калька з «зробити».

items.pattern: post a photo / a video online
items.meaning: put a photo, video or message on the internet for other people to see
items.example: Mum **posted** a photo of our cake online.
more: Don't **post** your home address online.
She **posts** a new drawing every Friday.
items.watchOut: В інтернеті — online, без in: post it online. Можна також put it online.

items.pattern: leave (sb) a voicemail · leave a message
items.meaning: say a message on the phone when the other person doesn't answer
items.example: The dentist didn't answer, so Mum **left a voicemail**.
more: Please **leave a voicemail** after the beep.
When I'm busy, people **leave** me a **voicemail**.
items.watchOut: Залишити повідомлення — leave a voicemail, не make і не do. «Голосове» в месенджері частіше називають a voice message.

items.pattern: text sb · text sb sth · a text
items.meaning: send a short written message by phone
items.example: Mum **texted** me: 'Dinner is ready!'
more: **Text** me the name of the café, please.
I got a **text** from my aunt this morning.
items.watchOut: Написати комусь — text sb, без to: Text me! Не text to me і не write me SMS.

items.pattern: get / send / read a message · a message from sb
items.meaning: words that you write and send to someone's phone
items.example: There's a **message** from Ivan: 'Happy birthday!'
more: I'll send you a **message** after school.
My phone beeps every time I get a **message**.
items.watchOut: Отримати повідомлення — get a message, не take a message. Take a message — записати повідомлення для когось іншого.

items.pattern: download an app / a game / music
items.meaning: copy an app or a file from the internet onto your phone
items.example: We **downloaded an app** with bird songs for our trip to the forest.
more: Ask your parents before you **download** a new game.
This film is big. It takes ten minutes to **download**.
items.watchOut: Завантажити на телефон — download. Upload — навпаки: вивантажити з телефона в інтернет.

items.pattern: call sb · give sb a call
items.meaning: speak to someone on the phone
items.example: Can you **call** the pizza place and order two pizzas?
more: My aunt **called** from Canada last night.
**Call** me when you get to the station.
items.watchOut: Дзвонити комусь — call sb, без to: I called my mum. Не called to my mum.

items.pattern: be locked · lock your phone
items.meaning: closed, so you need a PIN or your finger to use it
items.example: My phone is **locked**, so my little brother can't play games on it.
more: **Lock** your tablet before you leave the room.
The screen is **locked**. Swipe up to open it.
items.watchOut: Заблокований телефон — locked, а не blocked. Block sb — заблокувати людину в контактах чи соцмережі, це інше.

items.pattern: a PIN · enter / type your PIN
items.meaning: a secret number that you use to open your phone or use a bank card
items.example: Choose a **PIN** that is easy for you to remember but hard for others to guess.
more: I typed the wrong **PIN** three times!
Never tell anyone your **PIN**.
items.watchOut: Вимова /pɪn/, як слово pin (шпилька). Кажуть просто PIN; PIN code і PIN number теж часто чути.

items.pattern: unlock your phone · unlock the screen
items.meaning: open a locked phone so you can use it
items.example: I use my fingerprint to **unlock** my phone.
more: Dad can't **unlock** his new phone. He forgot the PIN!
**Unlock** the screen and open the camera.
items.watchOut: Un- на початку означає «навпаки»: lock — заблокувати, unlock — розблокувати.

items.pattern: swipe (the screen) left / right / up / down
items.meaning: move your finger quickly across the screen
items.example: **Swipe** down to see your messages.
more: My grandma learned to **swipe** through photos very quickly.
**Swipe** left to see the next page of the book.

items.pattern: save a photo / a number / a file
items.meaning: keep a photo, number or file on your phone so you have it later
items.example: I **saved** the photo of the rainbow. It's beautiful!
more: Did you **save** the address of the hotel?
My phone **saves** all my notes.
items.watchOut: Save має ще два значення: «рятувати» (save a cat) і «заощаджувати» (save money).

items.pattern: phone memory · the memory is full · not enough memory
items.meaning: the space on a phone for photos, apps and music
items.example: Videos take a lot of **memory**.
more: The **memory** on my old phone is very small.
Delete the old videos and you'll have more **memory**.
items.watchOut: Пам'ять заповнена — the memory is full. Memory — це й пам'ять людини: I have a good memory.

items.pattern: delete a photo / a message / an app
items.meaning: take something off your phone so it is gone
items.example: I **deleted** all the bad photos from the trip.
more: **Delete** the games you don't play.
Oops! I **deleted** your message before I read it.
items.watchOut: Вимова /dɪˈliːt/ — наголос на другому складі.

warmup.explain: Фото і селфі «роблять» дієсловом take: take a selfie.
Дзвонити комусь — call sb, без to.

warmup.q: Please ___ me when you get home.
warmup.explain: Text sb — написати комусь, без to.

warmup.uk: Він не відповів, тож я залишила йому повідомлення на автовідповідачі.
warmup.q: He didn't answer, so I ___ him a voicemail.
warmup.explain: Залишити голосове повідомлення — leave a voicemail.
Заблокований телефон — locked. Blocked — про людину, яку ти заблокував у контактах.
Пам'ять телефона — memory. Mind — розум, remember — дієслово «пам'ятати».

warmup.uk: Давай завантажимо цей застосунок. Він безкоштовний.
warmup.explain: Завантажити на телефон — download. Upload — навпаки, вивантажити в інтернет.

A.q: My phone is nearly dead. Where's my ___?
A.explain: Щоб зарядити телефон, потрібен зарядний пристрій — charger.

A.q: The ___ on my phone isn't very good, so my photos are dark.
I always keep my phone in a ___ because I drop it a lot.
A.explain: Чохол, який захищає телефон, — phone case.

B.q: I didn't want to talk, so I ___ him: 'See you at five!'
B.explain: Не хотів говорити — значить, написав: texted. Called — подзвонив.

B.q: We ___ a selfie at the top of the mountain.
B.explain: Take a selfie, у минулому часі — took.

B.q: There's a cool new game. Can I ___ it?

C.q: To see the next photo, ___ the screen to the left.
You've got too many old messages. Why don't you ___ some?
Nobody can use my phone without my ___.
C.explain: Секретне число, яким відкривають телефон, — PIN.

example.title: A selfie with a giraffe
example.uk:
У суботу Мія пішла з татом до зоопарку. Вона хотіла зробити селфі з жирафом. Але батарея в її телефоні майже сіла, а зарядного пристрою з собою не було!

Потім телефон написав: «Пам'ять заповнена». Мія видалила кілька старих фото. Нарешті вона всміхнулася в камеру, а позаду неї стояв жираф.

Увечері Мія виклала фото в інтернет. Через десять хвилин їй зателефонувала бабуся. «Мені дуже подобається твій новий друг!» — засміялася вона.
example.en:
On Saturday, Mia went to the zoo with her dad. She wanted to [[take a selfie|b1]] with a giraffe. But her phone's [[battery|a7]] was low, and she didn't have her [[charger|a6]]!

Then her phone said, 'Your [[memory|c6]] is full.' Mia [[deleted|c7]] some old photos. At last, she smiled at the [[camera|a1]] with the giraffe behind her.

In the evening, Mia [[posted|b2]] the photo online. Ten minutes later, Grandma [[called|b7]] her. 'I love your new friend!' she laughed.
